description: Each partial or missing showcase coverage request should become a targeted component candidate seed with domain, role, cost profile, deployment target, risk tier, labels, and source gap provenance.

Gap-derived seeds must export the standard row families: normalized objects, source records, canonical entities, entity refs, dedupe clusters, labels, dimensions, embedding work, review tickets, and index records.
Gap-derived candidates improve template coverage but do not promote or publish components. High-risk rows remain review-gated before promotion.
